summary: A recent discussion proposes adding a logical type, VECTOR (or FINITE_VECTOR), to Parquet to represent fixed-length numeric vectors and enforce constraints such as non-null and finite. The outcome of the focused call is to consider this addition.

highlights.text: Adding a logical type VECTOR (or FINITE_VECTOR) to represent fixed-length numeric vectors with constraints such as non-null and finite.

sources.title: Re: [DISCUSS] Numeric Vector type: physical representation (outcome of focused call)
